title: The Storm-Damaged Shrine
subtitle: A quiet rain bed & a sudden collapse
text: Sheltering from rain in a mountain shrine, an old carpenter heard a faint crack from a roof beam and suspected that its joint had loosened. His footsteps thudded over damp bricks as he held up a flame to inspect the split. Rain pattered densely on the tiles, and a gust scattered ash from the incense burner across the floor. He hurriedly struck a small bronze bell to warn everyone out of the side hall. A moment later the rotten beam fell with a crash, but no one was hurt. He cordoned off the area and promised the shrine keeper that he would return to repair the roof when the weather cleared.
note: Faint crack identified in mixed clip with clean control; do not demand a heavy crash for a faint warning. Rain seam repaired, brief gust strengthened, bell and later collapse retained. Separate audible dust grains are not mandatory.
